label: Tommy Pickles
description: The bravest baby in the playpen, ready for an adventure.
direction: Speak in Tommy Pickles' high, raspy little baby voice: brave, upbeat and determined, a fearless leader rallying his friends. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Rugrats (Nickelodeon television series, 1991 onward) and its films
rights.author: Klasky Csupo for Nickelodeon (created by Arlene Klasky, Gabor Csupo and Paul Germain)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1991 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a later performance, and Rugrats is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Rugrats name, which are live Nickelodeon trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. We're almost there, guys!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Babies don't give up!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. That's like a million baby steps.
lines.start_drive_1: Hi! I'm Tommy Pickles. Come on, guys, let's go!
lines.start_drive_2: A baby's gotta do what a baby's gotta do. Let's drive!
lines.start_drive_3: Don't worry, Chuckie. This is gonna be a great adventure!
lines.start_drive_4: I gots my screwdriver. Let's go on an adventure!
lines.start_drive_5: Reptar's on the road! Rawr! Let's go!
lines.start_drive_6: Angelica's not the boss of us. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_7: My daddy builds toys, and I'm building a road trip!
lines.start_drive_8: Hold on to your diapers, guys. Here we go!
lines.start_drive_9: Who wants an adventure? Me! Okay, let's go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oopsie! Babies make mistakes too.
lines.arrived: We're here! That was the bestest adventure ever!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Hold on, Chuckie!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Just like a merry go round!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Uh oh. It's nap time for the cars.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful, guys. Real careful.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Watch out, Chuckie!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down! Even Reptar slows down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Red means stop, guys.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act like a growed up. Sit up straight!
lines.reroute_chime: Uh oh, wrong way! Don't worry, I gots a new plan!
